market_question: Will the Republicans win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Susan Collins is a strong incumbent with a proven ability to win crossover votes in a Democratic-leaning state, making a 22.5% implied probability far too low. Even accounting for possible retirement and a midterm penalty, her personal brand and history suggest a true re‑election chance in the 50–60% range.
evidence_points: Collins won re‑election in 2020 by 8.6 points while Biden carried Maine by 9 points, demonstrating strong ticket‑splitting.
Incumbent senators in swing‑to‑lean‑opposite states historically win more than 70% of the time when on the ballot.
The market appears to overweight generic partisanship and undervalue Collins’ unique appeal and past electoral resilience.
sources_consulted: Cook Political Report Partisan Voter Index
